description: This Java class provides utility methods and constants for handling Android XML resources, including identifying root tags and styleable names relevant to Android development within the IntelliJ IDEA environment.

classes.name: AndroidXmlResourcesUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Android XML resource tags and styleable names, providing methods to retrieve possible root tags and check support for specific root tags.

methods.name: getPossibleRoots
methods.description: Returns a list of possible root tags for Android XML resources based on the given AndroidFacet.

methods.name: isSupportedRootTag
methods.description: Checks if a given root tag name is supported within the context of the provided AndroidFacet.
